description: This file contains the implementation of the UserGroup class within the Admin Model namespace of the OpenCart project. It defines methods for managing user groups, including adding, editing, deleting, fetching, and managing permissions for user groups.

classes.name: UserGroup
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing user groups in the admin section of OpenCart, including CRUD operations and permission management.

methods.name: addUserGroup
methods.description: Adds a new user group to the database with specified data, returning the new user group's ID.

methods.name: editUserGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing user group identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteUserGroup
methods.description: Deletes a user group from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getUserGroup
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific user group by its ID, including name and permissions.

methods.name: getUserGroups
methods.description: Returns a list of all user groups with optional ordering, start, and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalUserGroups
methods.description: Returns the total number of user groups in the database.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a specified permission route to a user group.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a specific permission route from a user group.
